name: Captain Shatterskull
summary: At Mor'shan Base Camp, Captain Shatterskull commands the Horde's northern border defense. A seasoned orc commander, he coordinates efforts to repel night elf forces contesting the border near Warsong Gulch.

sections.title: Guardian of the Northern Border
sections.body: At Mor'shan Base Camp, Captain Shatterskull guards the Horde's foothold at the edge of Ashenvale. He works beside fellow officers such as Kadrak against night elf sentinels and Silverwing forces seeking to reclaim the borderlands. The struggle over Ashenvale's timber and ancient lands keeps the Barrens frontier under constant threat.

faq.answer: Captain Shatterskull is a seasoned orc commander at Mor'shan Base Camp, overseeing the Horde's defense against night elf forces.

faq.q: Where can Captain Shatterskull be found?
faq.answer: You can find Captain Shatterskull at Mor'shan Base Camp on the northern edge of the Barrens, before Ashenvale.

faq.q: What is his role at Mor'shan Base Camp?
faq.answer: At Mor'shan Base Camp, Captain Shatterskull commands the defense of the Horde's northern frontier and rallies warriors against the Alliance's Silverwing Sentinels.

faq.q: Who does Captain Shatterskull work with?
faq.answer: Captain Shatterskull works alongside frontline officers such as Kadrak, coordinating defense and recruitment for border skirmishes.

angles.text: For Horde warriors arriving from the southern Barrens, Captain Shatterskull guards the northern frontier against night elf incursions from Ashenvale.
As an orc, Captain Shatterskull's defense of the Horde's hard-won lands reflects the martial spirit of a people others view as invaders.
